name: persistence-wiring
goal: Wire persistence into the actual UI. First read logic.js and storage.js, then make one small edit in storage.js: rename its ALLOWED_MOODS, MAX_NOTE_LENGTH and MAX_HISTORY_SIZE constants and their uses to distinct STORAGE_* names. These classic scripts currently collide at the top level; do not reread unchanged files before this edit. Next read index.html and index.js, load storage.js before index.js, and connect startup load, save and clear to the existing UI state. The owner-provided ui.test.js is a JSDOM-free real-script test; preserve it and consult it for concrete test details. Keep controls usable on throwing storage access or failed writes/clears and show an honest visible warning. Preserve logic and protected tests. Run lint/build/test after implementation.

name: documentation
goal: Read README.md and update only that file to accurately explain operation, reload/clear persistence, storage-error behavior and the available test command. Do not claim a browser check occurred.
